name: window_matches
description: team matches in the scoring window (the last N completed matches of the player's team as of the date)

name: min_team_matches
description: minimum team matches for a score to exist

name: competition_weight_rank1
description: multiplier on the whole score for level_rank 1 competitions

name: competition_weight_rank2
description: multiplier on the whole score for level_rank 2 competitions

name: competition_weight_rank3
description: multiplier on the whole score for level_rank 3 competitions

name: production_ref_fwd
description: goals plus 0.7 assists per 90 that scores full production for forwards

name: production_ref_mid
description: goals plus 0.7 assists per 90 that scores full production for midfielders

name: conceded_ref
description: goals conceded per 90 at which the defensive production component reaches zero

name: form_delta_days
description: days back for the score change that drives the state

name: rising_delta
description: score change (points) for En alza / En baja

name: on_fire_score
description: score at or above which a rising player is En racha

name: established_score
description: score at or above which a stable player is Titular fijo

name: short_minutes_share
description: minutes share below which a player is Poco rodaje

name: absent_team_matches
description: team matches without minutes that put a player in the infirmary as absent

name: just_moved_days
description: days after a club change during which the state is Recién llegado

name: back_days
description: days after a return from absence during which the state is Volvió

name: arrow_default_days
description: days back for the rank arrow when no squad announcement date is earlier than the horizon

name: domestic_watch_slots
description: players from the Argentine league admitted to the watch per position at each date (the best by score)
